notes.title: Release notes 1.097
notes.content:
We have updated several libraries, fixed bugs, but most importantly, prepared updates for mods.

If you encounter bugs welcome to our discord:  
[url=https://discord.gg/gPwG6K9VRK]Retora Games Discord[/url]

notes.title: The Scribe Expansion!
notes.content:
The Scribe Expansion is now out for all Steam users! 

This expansion includes:
[list]
[*] Dungeon Maps, A new way to fight enemies
[*] A new Crafter, the Scribe, to make maps and scrolls
[*] Crafter Prestiging, with the ability to prestige items
[*] 3 Additional hero slots
[*] Another page of inventory
[*] New enemies & items
[*] more things I can't remember but I swear they are there
[*] bug fixes, always fixing bugs, and adding more bugs, I literally can't even 
[/list]

As with the Frozen Tome, this is a paid expansion. We'll be doing giveaways this week on the Reddit and Discord, so keep an eye out if your wallet is tight. 

Cheers!
-Tyler & the Merchant Team

notes.title: Spooky Updates!
notes.content:
Happy Halloween!
We just pushed an update to live with a couple features for everyone to enjoy!

[list]
[*] Spooky Spooky Boss
[*] Added Repeat Quest Button
[*] Add save slots with new game modes
[*] Bug fixes after Steam launch
[/list]

As always, thanks for playing, let us know if you have any questions or bugs to report in the Steam community or the Discord.

notes.title: First Steam Update
notes.content:
Hey all,
Thanks for sticking with us through this launch! We've had a blast hanging out in the Steam Broadcast and playing with you all. Today we pushed our first PC update that adds PC-specific updates based on your feedback. 

The first big thing added is Mouse Scroll. This should work on all scrolling screens.This is probably the most requested feature so far, and so we're very excited to make it available asap. 

We've also added the side banners (shown in the stream) to the game, based on your Shop's theme. Change the theme, change the side banners. This is great for anyone who wants to play at full screen. They are built for 1920x1080 max, but if there's enough interest, we can build out larger banners. 

We're still looking to improve on the PC version, so let us know what else you'd like to see to help the PC experience! 
-Tyler
